Oh, I totally blanked on the email I used—sorry! But my name’s Chen Silva and my zip code is 46281. Will that work?

Wait, seriously? That’s so frustrating! I really wanted the money back on my credit card. You know what, just forget it—I want to return both tablets now and get everything refunded to a gift card instead. Can you help me with that? I’m honestly pretty annoyed right now.
Yeah, that’s right. I want to send both of them back and just get the refunds on my gift card. Please go ahead and start the return for both tablets. Thanks.
Alright, thanks for helping me out. I’ll keep an eye out for those emails. That’s all I needed for now!
